evidence_statement: The paper states that procedural knowledge was tested by executing the task without assistance.
object_definition: Practical knowledge demonstrated through unaided performance of the electronic wiring task.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The traditional AR system presented assembly instructions so that users could acquire skills in wiring the system.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Successful completion of the second-sensor task required the right understanding of the electronic system to identify the correct power-source connection.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Participants wired a second sensor without guidance to assess whether acquired knowledge could be applied to a different situation.
object_definition: Ability to apply acquired knowledge to a new but similar practical situation.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: All thirteen participants were students.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The paper-based document served as the control learning interface and contained textual instructions and pictures for the wiring task.
object_definition: Nondigital learning approach based on a paper document containing task information and instructions.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The traditional AR system presented component overviews, text, graphical arrows, and videos, including step-by-step assembly instructions over the workspace.
object_definition: Implemented AR training interface representing typical assembly-training AR.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The enhanced system added multimodal voice cues, contextual information, and common mistakes and consequences to the traditional AR content.
object_definition: Implemented AR training interface designed to encourage meaningful learning and knowledge reuse.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The enhanced AR system used voice cues to provide additional context and instructions to users.
object_definition: Implemented multimodal information-delivery component of the enhanced AR system.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The enhanced AR system included a common mistakes and consequences panel after each step.
object_definition: Implemented AR component presenting common errors and their consequences.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The developed AR system was targeted on a head-mounted display, Microsoft HoloLens 2.
object_definition: Head-mounted mixed-reality display used to superimpose holographic content on the real environment.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The AR application was developed using Unity engine.
object_definition: Multiplatform software engine used to develop the AR application.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Vuforia Engine was used as the vision-based tracking library.
object_definition: Augmented- and mixed-reality SDK used for image identification and tracking.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The user interface was developed using the Mixed Reality Toolkit proposed by Microsoft for HoloLens 2.
object_definition: Toolkit providing mixed-reality interface and interaction features.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Vuforia compared natural characteristics extracted from the camera image against a predefined target resource database.
object_definition: Structured image-target resource used to identify and track the experiment's image target.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Paper-based manual users needed to scan all information before deciding which section was essential and relevant to task completion.
object_definition: Search and selection burden inherent in using the paper-based material.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The paper attributes the paper-based group's lower scores partly to more extraneous processing and states that scanning the manual imposes more workload.
object_definition: Cognitive processing that does not directly serve the instructional goal or promote transfer.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Existing AR training often presents information passively, and traditional AR users may be conditioned solely as information receivers and implementers.
object_definition: Learner passivity that restricts thinking, sensemaking, and effective retention.

node_name: information isolated to a specific sub-task or process
case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Traditional AR information is often isolated to a specific sub-task or process and may not suit a complex system with highly interrelated components.
object_definition: Decontextualization of information from wider system behavior and relationships.

node_name: difficulty tracking components without associated 3D models
case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Targeting different components was difficult without associated 3D models, which would need to be created for that purpose.
object_definition: Tracking limitation affecting component-based AR targeting when 3D models are unavailable.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The paper states that small objects such as wires are difficult to track because of their size.
object_definition: AR tracking limitation arising from the small size of objects such as wires.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: Additional contextual information such as sound cues and condition-consequence states may increase learning time because users must attend to more information.
object_definition: Additional training time associated with processing the enhanced system's extra contextual information.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The experimental task required participants to wire a power supply, voltage regulator board, terminal block, sensor, Arduino board, and breadboard.
object_definition: Internally provided physical equipment and workspace required to conduct the electronic-wiring training and performance tasks.

case_title: Augmented reality training for improved learnability
evidence_statement: The Vuforia Engine identifies and tracks an image by comparing natural characteristics extracted from the camera picture with the predefined target resource database.
